sloka: प्रसन्न मुख वर्णः च व्यक्तम् हृष्टः च भाषते ।न अनृतम् वक्ष्यते वीरो हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः ॥४-४-३२॥
transliteration: prasanna mukha varṇaḥ ca vyaktam hṛṣṭaḥ ca bhāṣate ।na anṛtam vakṣyate vīro hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ ॥4-4-32॥

translations.english: 'It is evident from his words and from his cheerful face that Hanuman is pleased. (I know that) this heroic son of the Windgod will never tell a lie'.
